allowed_treatment_difference: B preserves native trace_id and span_id when an active span exists; A does not gain trace/span correlation
policy: canonical_log_classification(log) is shared by normalization, parity, audit sampling, and reports; retain explicit application errors/warnings and recognized application diagnostics; exclude known health/runtime/lifecycle noise, the narrowly classified Transaction processed success event when request metrics and trace outcome represent the same completion, and UNKNOWN by default; all excluded records remain in RAW; never filter using fault metadata, scenario data, or Ground Truth
